title: Re: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim's Revengeance
description: Re: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim's Revengeance — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul again in Vergrim's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay 8 Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters again and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters again, then return to the Townston Commander...again.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul again in Vergrim's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay 8 Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters again and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters again, then return to the Townston Commander...again.

Offer:

With the Townston Alchemical Association moments away from a major breakthrough I need you to continue to put the pressure on Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to keep it from being unleashed on the rest of the dungeon. Do you think you can do that? I know it gets a little monotonous, but think about it this way, wouldn't you rather be here than riding on some lame made up creature that is half eagle and half lion. Actually, when I say it like that it doesn't sound so bad...I mean, doesn't that sound AWFUL!?

Go to Vergrim's Revenge, off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, which is located off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Get there and unleash the Dungeon Runner within! Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul, 8 of Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters, and 6 Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters. When you are done, wash your hands, then return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

No time for high fives, I need you to do this again. Are you ready?

Objectives:

  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul
  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Blademaster
  • Slay Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters

Client level range: 79–100
